penalties.details: Adjudicating Officer (AO) on the basis of power vested to him pursuant to section 454(1) passed an order against the Sandhar Han Shin Auto Technologies Private Limited and its Directors, (Joint Venture Company of Sandhar Technologies Limited )for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. Further, one of the current Director of JV Company is also a KMP of the Sandhar and AO has imposed a penalty of INR 50,000/- against him for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. On 19 Dec 2025 director of the Company has received an order from the office of AO for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. Further as per the infromation received from the director, he wishes to file an appeal before the Officer of Hob'ble Regional Director (NR) against the order of AO. So, pursuant to sub-para 20 of para A of Part A of Schedule III, we are providing the details for the same.
penalties.impact: No impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Jayant Davar, as Promoter, declared no encumbrance on Sandhar Technologies shares by 31 March 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,306.99 Cr (+28.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹63.82 Cr (+49.8% YoY).
Sandhar Technologies reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,306.99 Cr and net profit of ₹63.82 Cr.
Sandhar Technologies Limited made the Q4 FY26 audited financial results investor call recording available on its website on 25 May 2026 via **Yashpal Jain (CFO & Company Secretary)**.
On May 22, 2026, India Ratings reaffirmed Sandhar Technologies' long-term bank facilities at IND AA-/Stable and commercial paper at IND A1+.
Sandhar Technologies reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,307 Cr and guided for over 15% revenue growth in FY27.
On 3 June 2026, ICRA assigned first-time ratings of [ICRA]AA-(Stable)/[ICRA]A1+ to Sandhar Technologies' ₹885 Cr of term loan, working capital and unallocated bank facilities.
Q1FY27 results: Revenue of ₹1,382 Cr (highest ever), up 27% YoY; EBITDA of ₹117 Cr, up 15% YoY; PAT of ₹37 Cr, up 33% YoY
